conventions.lock: a:b -> height (a-b)/(a+b), f0 = 2*baseHz/(a+b), x rate b*f0, y rate a*f0
conventions.pitch_x_base: dominant harmonic * 2/(a+b): multiply by baseHz for the pitch you hear
conventions.shares: longitude-averaged energy share per harmonic (DC removed)
conventions.lon_range: dominant harmonic share, min..max over 32 longitudes (exact, coherent)
conventions.lon_doms: every harmonic that is loudest at some longitude: one entry = longitude cannot re-voice it
conventions.purest: the longitude where one harmonic carries the most energy, that harmonic, its share
conventions.lon_spectra: 16 longitudes (0, 1/16, ...) x harmonics 1..16, exact shares, for the playable atlas
conventions.row_doms: pole only: loudest harmonic at each of 32 rows (longitude picks the row)
conventions.pole: height -1, row-averaged; pitch multiple 2*m; row_spectra = 16 rows x harmonics 1..16
